reopening a direction clears its incident hash
inbound halt rejects proof consumption before replay state mutates
outbound halt rejects message creation before the outbound nonce advances
halting one direction does not halt the opposite direction
emergency state cannot rewrite verifier, gateway, asset or route configuration
emergency controls add no custody, confiscation, mint or burn authority
existing GatewayRouter420 system-level safety remains authoritative and unchanged
